testName: Service Resource Operating Hours, Shifts & Territory Membership
steps:
1. Open Service Resources tab
2. Open record "Carlos Rivera"
3. Open Service Territory Memberships related list
4. Verify Primary Territory is "Midwest Metro" with Operating Hours "Standard 8AM-5PM CST"
5. Attempt to schedule a Service Appointment at 7:00 PM (outside operating hours)
6. Verify scheduling engine flags rule violation: "Violates Resource Operating Hours"
7. Reschedule to 10:00 AM within normal shift hours
8. Verify validation passes with zero rule violations
